key: BENNETT: Well met again, \PN.
en: BENNETT: Well met again, \PN.
ja: ベネット: また会えたな、\PN。

key: How do you like the room?
en: How do you like the room?
ja: この部屋、気に入っていただけましたか?

key: I was allowed to take over here after we realized the position had been vacant.
en: I was allowed to take over here after we realized the position had been vacant.
ja: この地位が空席になっていると分かった後、私が引き継ぐことを許されたのです。

key: It is curious-- there isn't even a single record of whomever held the spot before.
en: It is curious-- there isn't even a single record of whomever held the spot before.
ja: 奇妙なことに、以前この地位にあった者の記録すら、一つも残っていません。

key: Even Elias cannot recall them.
en: Even Elias cannot recall them.
ja: イライアスでさえ、その者のことを思い出せないのです。

key: And of course, that makes his whole gambit with forcing Laura out all the more despicable.
en: And of course, that makes his whole gambit with forcing Laura out all the more despicable.
ja: そしてもちろん、それゆえに、ローラを追い出した彼の策略が、なおのこと卑劣に思えるのです。

key: Perhaps he was simply always senile.
en: Perhaps he was simply always senile.
ja: もしかすると、彼はただずっと老いぼれていただけかもしれませんが。

key: In any case, I hope you can appreciate the decor.
en: In any case, I hope you can appreciate the decor.
ja: いずれにせよ、この内装を気に入っていただければ幸いです。

key: I don't know if my position in the order will be permanent, but as Anna has been indisposed, I was allowed to redecorate.
en: I don't know if my position in the order will be permanent, but as Anna has been indisposed, I was allowed to redecorate.
ja: 私が教団でのこの地位に永続的に就くかは分かりませんが、アンナが体調を崩していたので、模様替えを許されたのです。

key: FLORA: ...Okay, yeah, so, about that...
en: FLORA: ...Okay, yeah, so, about that...
ja: フローラ: ……ええと、そうそう、それなんだけど……

key: Are you gay, or a Bug Type Trainer?
en: Are you gay, or a Bug Type Trainer?
ja: あんた、ゲイなわけ、それともむしタイプトレーナーなわけ?

key: There's a wrong answer there, and I need to know how much to judge you.
en: There's a wrong answer there, and I need to know how much to judge you.
ja: どっちかが不正解なんだけど、どれくらいバカにすればいいか知っときたくて。

key: BENNETT: Bennett Voclain, aspiring combatant and lepidopterist, at your service.
en: BENNETT: Bennett Voclain, aspiring combatant and lepidopterist, at your service.
ja: ベネット: ベネット・ヴォクラン、闘士を目指す者、そしてりんし類学者です。お見知りおきを。

key: FLORA: ...That doesn't answer my question.
en: FLORA: ...That doesn't answer my question.
ja: フローラ: ……それ、答えになってないんだけど。

key: ...Does it?
en: ...Does it?
ja: ……なってる?

key: Does that mean he's gay?
en: Does that mean he's gay?
ja: それって、ゲイってこと?

key: BENNETT: It means I study-- well, truthfully, all manner of Bug Types-- but particularly four-winged larvae- bearing insects such as butterflies and moths.
en: BENNETT: It means I study-- well, truthfully, all manner of Bug Types-- but particularly four-winged larvae- bearing insects such as butterflies and moths.
ja: ベネット: つまり、私が研究しているのは――正直、あらゆるむしタイプなのですが――特に、チョウやガのような四枚羽根の幼虫を持つ昆虫です。

key: FLORA: Okay, so it's the wrong answer then.
en: FLORA: Okay, so it's the wrong answer then.
ja: フローラ: なるほど、じゃあ不正解ってことね。

key: Disgusting.
en: Disgusting.
ja: 気持ち悪い。

key: You should've just said you were gay.
en: You should've just said you were gay.
ja: 素直にゲイだって言えばよかったのに。

key: BENNETT: I'll... keep that in mind?
en: BENNETT: I'll... keep that in mind?
ja: ベネット: それは……心に留めておきましょう?

key: It seems our roles are reversed from our last battle, \PN.
en: It seems our roles are reversed from our last battle, \PN.
ja: 前回の対戦とは、立場が逆転したようだな、\PN。

key: Now I'm the one facing down two Trainers working in tandem.
en: Now I'm the one facing down two Trainers working in tandem.
ja: 今度は私の方が、息の合った二人のトレーナーを相手にする番だ。

key: But I can only assume that the two of you work together just fine, as you've already beaten Laura.
en: But I can only assume that the two of you work together just fine, as you've already beaten Laura.
ja: だが、君たち二人は問題なく連携できると見ている、すでにローラを倒しているのだからな。

key: Part of me wishes I could have still fought you both with her as my partner.
en: Part of me wishes I could have still fought you both with her as my partner.
ja: 心のどこかでは、まだ彼女をパートナーにして君たち二人と戦いたかったという気持ちもある。

key: FLORA: Wait-- THAT girl was YOUR partner?
en: FLORA: Wait-- THAT girl was YOUR partner?
ja: フローラ: え待って――あの子があんたのパートナーだったの?

key: BENNETT: Ah-- a misunderstanding.
en: BENNETT: Ah-- a misunderstanding.
ja: ベネット: ああ――誤解だな。

key: We are partners for battling; no more than that, at least for the time.
en: We are partners for battling; no more than that, at least for the time.
ja: 私たちはバトルのパートナーだ。少なくとも今のところ、それ以上のものではない。

key: FLORA: Okay, PHEW.
en: FLORA: Okay, PHEW.
ja: フローラ: ふう、よかった。

key: I was gonna say, BIG YIKES, if someone like her were with a creep like you.
en: I was gonna say, BIG YIKES, if someone like her were with a creep like you.
ja: あんたみたいな気持ち悪い奴と、あの子みたいな人がくっついてたら、マジでドン引きだと思ったし。

key: BENNETT: I...
en: BENNETT: I...
ja: ベネット: 私は……

key: ...Wish to respect your opinion, of course, but I admit I am a bit aghast to still be called that.
en: ...Wish to respect your opinion, of course, but I admit I am a bit aghast to still be called that.
ja: ……もちろん君の意見は尊重したいが、いまだにそう呼ばれることには、いささかがく然としていることを認めよう。

key: I do maintain proper hygiene, and although I've done things in the past that I am deeply ashamed of, I have tried my best to learn to listen and respect others' boundaries in both action and thought.
en: I do maintain proper hygiene, and although I've done things in the past that I am deeply ashamed of, I have tried my best to learn to listen and respect others' boundaries in both action and thought.
ja: 清潔さもきちんと保っているし、過去には深く恥じている行いもあったが、行動においても思考においても、他者の境界を聞き入れ、尊重することを学ぼうと最善を尽くしてきたつもりだ。

key: Might I selfishly ask, for the sake of my continued self-improvement, precisely what about me still comes across as "creepy"?
en: Might I selfishly ask, for the sake of my continued self-improvement, precisely what about me still comes across as "creepy"?
ja: 自分勝手ではあるが、今後の自己改善のために尋ねたい。一体私の何が、いまだに「気持ち悪い」と映るのだろうか?

key: FLORA: Oh-- I mean, you seem fine aside from the Bug Types. It's just them.
en: FLORA: Oh-- I mean, you seem fine aside from the Bug Types. It's just them.
ja: フローラ: ああ――むしタイプ以外は普通じゃない? それだけよ。

key: Yuck.
en: Yuck.
ja: うげ。

key: BENNETT: ...Ah.
en: BENNETT: ...Ah.
ja: ベネット: ……ああ。

key: Perhaps we should just get on with the battle, and then you will be free to be rid of me.
en: Perhaps we should just get on with the battle, and then you will be free to be rid of me.
ja: おそらく、バトルを進めた方がいいだろう。そうすれば、君はすぐに私から解放される。

key: I hope you understand that, despite being aware of your feelings on my type, I cannot hold back.
en: I hope you understand that, despite being aware of your feelings on my type, I cannot hold back.
ja: 君の気持ちは承知しているが、それでも手加減はできないということを、理解してもらえるとありがたい。

key: FLORA: Yeahyeahyeah, whatever, I'll put you in the fucking dirt.
en: FLORA: Yeahyeahyeah, whatever, I'll put you in the fucking dirt.
ja: フローラ: はいはいはい、どうでもいいから、あんたをぶっ潰してやるわ。

key: Bring it, bug boy!
en: Bring it, bug boy!
ja: かかってきなさいよ、むし野郎!

key: FLORA: ...\PN.
en: FLORA: ...\PN.
ja: フローラ: ……\PN。

key: How did you come all the way here and not even bring a full team to fight with?
en: How did you come all the way here and not even bring a full team to fight with?
ja: こんなとこまで来ておいて、なんでフルの手勢も連れてこないわけ?

key: Do you WANT me to lose?
en: Do you WANT me to lose?
ja: あたしに負けてほしいの?

key: (Seriously, how did this moron ever get to be champion...)
en: (Seriously, how did this moron ever get to be champion...)
ja: (マジで、こんなバカがどうやってチャンピオンになったわけ……)

key: Go back and get some actual goddamn Pokémon before I lose my fucking patience already!
en: Go back and get some actual goddamn Pokémon before I lose my fucking patience already!
ja: いい加減あたしの堪忍袋の緒が切れる前に、戻ってちゃんとしたポケモンを連れてきなさいよ!

key: FLORA: Hey, \PN?
en: FLORA: Hey, \PN?
ja: フローラ: ねえ、\PN?

key: What are you doing?
en: What are you doing?
ja: 何やってんの?

key: Did you perhaps somehow manage to forget that you need to PICK SOME POKÉMON?!
en: Did you perhaps somehow manage to forget that you need to PICK SOME POKÉMON?!
ja: もしかして、「ポケモンを選ぶ」ってことすら忘れてたわけ?!

key: It was a satisfying battle, if an expected conclusion. I am honored to have held your time.
en: It was a satisfying battle, if an expected conclusion. I am honored to have held your time.
ja: 結末は　読めていたが　満ち足りた戦いだった。キミの時間を　いただけて　光栄だよ

key: FLORA: Wow, Bug AND Fire Types, AND you still lost!
en: FLORA: Wow, Bug AND Fire Types, AND you still lost!
ja: フローラ: うわ、むしタイプとほのおタイプ両方使って、それでも負けたわけ!

key: This region really IS pathetic!
en: This region really IS pathetic!
ja: この地方、マジで情けないわね!

key: BENNETT: ...It is possible, and perhaps even likely that I am out of my depth here,
en: BENNETT: ...It is possible, and perhaps even likely that I am out of my depth here,
ja: ベネット: ……私の手に負える相手ではなかったという可能性、いや、おそらくその通りなのだろう、

key: Though I feel obligated to remind you for the accuracy of your estimation that you are being escorted by the Champion...
en: Though I feel obligated to remind you for the accuracy of your estimation that you are being escorted by the Champion...
ja: だが、君の評価の正確性のために言っておくが、君を案内しているのはチャンピオンだということを、思い出させておく義務があると感じている……

key: FLORA: Hey, there's this cool new thing, have you heard about it?
en: FLORA: Hey, there's this cool new thing, have you heard about it?
ja: フローラ: ねえ、最近すごいの流行ってるって知ってる?

key: It's called "shutting up."
en: It's called "shutting up."
ja: 「黙る」って言うんだけど。

key: You should try it sometime.
en: You should try it sometime.
ja: 今度試してみたら?

key: We've got work to do now that we're done with all that; let us pass.
en: We've got work to do now that we're done with all that; let us pass.
ja: もうそれも済んだことだし、こっちには仕事があるから、通してくれ。

key: BENNETT: Of course.
en: BENNETT: Of course.
ja: ベネット: もちろんだ

key: I wish you the best of luck in your respective endeavors.
en: I wish you the best of luck in your respective endeavors.
ja: それぞれの取り組みに、幸運を祈っている。

key: FLORA: Finally. They should've just let us through in the first place.
en: FLORA: Finally. They should've just let us through in the first place.
ja: フローラ: やっと。最初から通してくれればよかったのに。

key: BENNETT: I will not be so foolish as to hold her disposition against you.
en: BENNETT: I will not be so foolish as to hold her disposition against you.
ja: ベネット: 彼女の気性を君のせいにするほど、私も愚かではないつもりだ。

key: I am choosing to take this as a lesson in gratitude.
en: I am choosing to take this as a lesson in gratitude.
ja: これは、感謝についての教訓として受け止めることにしよう。

key: It has made me appreciate Laura all that much more, for no small number of reasons.
en: It has made me appreciate Laura all that much more, for no small number of reasons.
ja: おかげで、ローラのありがたみが、少なからぬ理由でより一層分かった。

key: ...But I admit, her words did sting.
en: ...But I admit, her words did sting.
ja: ……だが正直、彼女の言葉は、確かに痛かった。

key: \PN, may I ask your opinion, as someone who has been witness to some of my... less dignified... moments?
en: \PN, may I ask your opinion, as someone who has been witness to some of my... less dignified...  moments?
ja: \PN、私の……あまり品位のない……瞬間を目にしてきた者として、君の意見を聞いてもいいだろうか?

key: Do you, even now, find me to be creepy?
en: Do you, even now, find me to be creepy?
ja: 今でも、私のことを気持ち悪いと思うか?

key: BENNETT: ...I see.
en: BENNETT: ...I see.
ja: ベネット: ……そうか。

key: Thank you for your honesty.
en: Thank you for your honesty.
ja: 正直に答えてくれてありがとう。

key: I will... continue to reflect on how best to improve and remedy that.
en: I will... continue to reflect on how best to improve and remedy that.
ja: それを改善する最良の方法について……引き続き考えていくとしよう。

key: In the meantime, I will try my best to impose on you as little as possible.
en: In the meantime, I will try my best to impose on you as little as possible.
ja: その間、できる限り君に迷惑をかけないよう努めよう。

key: BENNETT: ...Truly?
en: BENNETT: ...Truly?
ja: ベネット: ……本当か?

key: It does my heart no small amount of good to know that I've earned some amount of forgiveness.
en: It does my heart no small amount of good to know that I've earned some amount of forgiveness.
ja: いくらかの許しを得られたと知って、心が少なからず救われる思いだ。

key: But I have no intention of growing complacent.
en: But I have no intention of growing complacent.
ja: だが、それに甘んじるつもりはない。

key: This was merely a reality check after her harsh comments.
en: This was merely a reality check after her harsh comments.
ja: これは、彼女の辛辣な言葉の後の、単なる現実確認にすぎない。

key: Thank you for your kindness and your perspective.
en: Thank you for your kindness and your perspective.
ja: 君の優しさと、その視点に感謝する。

key: The company is always welcome.
en: The company is always welcome.
ja: 君と一緒にいられるのは、いつでも歓迎だ。

key: It continues to be a... learning experience to live up to the position that I have been placed in.
en: It continues to be a... learning experience to live up to the position that I have been placed in.
ja: 私が置かれたこの立場に見合う存在になろうとするのは……今も変わらず学びの経験だ。

key: I've been looking forward to this battle--
en: I've been looking forward to this battle--
ja: このバトルを楽しみにしていた――

key: Not only for the opportunity to test my skills, but for the chance to grow as well.
en: Not only for the opportunity to test my skills, but for the chance to grow as well.
ja: 自分の技量を試す機会としてだけでなく、成長する機会としても。

key: I do not intend to grow complacent with the kindness that you have granted me.
en: I do not intend to grow complacent with the kindness that you have granted me.
ja: 君が与えてくれた優しさに、甘んじるつもりはない。

key: There always remains something that I have yet to learn.
en: There always remains something that I have yet to learn.
ja: 学ぶべきことは、いつでも残っているものだ。

key: Show me what that might be today!
en: Show me what that might be today!
ja: 今日は、それが何なのか見せてもらおう!

key: This result was expected-- I'm grateful for the opportunity to learn from you regardless.
en: This result was expected-- I'm grateful for the opportunity to learn from you regardless.
ja: 想定どおりの結果だよ――それでも　キミから学ぶ機会を　得られたことに　感謝する

key: BENNETT: It would do me well to remind myself that you are still our Champion, and have earned that position rightfully.
en: BENNETT: It would do me well to remind myself that you are still our Champion, and have earned that position rightfully.
ja: ベネット: 君がいまだ我々のチャンピオンであり、その地位を正当に勝ち取ったのだと、自分に言い聞かせておくのが良いだろう。

key: Perhaps this loss does not reflect upon whether I have earned this role which I stand on.
en: Perhaps this loss does not reflect upon whether I have earned this role which I stand on.
ja: この敗北は、私が今立っているこの役割に見合う者かどうかを、必ずしも反映しているわけではないのかもしれない。

key: Thank you for your continued patience and good faith.
en: Thank you for your continued patience and good faith.
ja: 変わらぬ忍耐と誠意に感謝する。

key: I wish you the best of luck in any and all of your future endeavors, \PN.
en: I wish you the best of luck in any and all of your future endeavors, \PN.
ja: 君の今後のあらゆる取り組みに、幸運を祈っている、\PN。

key: BENNETT: Thank you for your continued patience and good faith.
en: BENNETT: Thank you for your continued patience and good faith.
ja: ベネット: 変わらぬ忍耐と誠意に感謝する。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
